interactions.with: GLOSS.area-of-effect (lines from the origin; Total Cover blocks, R-34)
interactions.note: A Line would reuse the area-of-effect cover rule from its origin. Nothing in scope creates a Line, so this can't be reached.

interactions.with: R-26/R-27 (Cone width centred on the axis; centre of the creature's space decides)
interactions.note: Stage A proposes the same centring and the same centre-of-space test for Lines. This only matters once something creates a Line.
Measuring a diagonal Line's length with the grid metric versus Euclidean geometry is an open question (stage A ambiguity 2).

interactions.with: R-28 (full length unless the effect offers a shorter one)
interactions.note: This is the same 2014 'up to its length' trap as for Cones.

interactions.with: R-29 / R-31 (creature at the origin left out); T-78 (the creator's choice to include it)
interactions.note: Handled the same way as Cones and Cubes.

No in-scope spell, monster or species has a Line area. Burning Hands is a Cone, Thunderwave and Web are Cubes, and Sleep is a Sphere. Lightning Bolt (level 3), Dragonborn breath and dragons are outside §1.1. geometry.in_area supports only cone, cube and sphere, and raises 'no geometry' for anything else.

abuse.case: Bending a Line's width to one side, widening it from the axis to each side, cutting it short, or measuring a diagonal Line with the grid metric (new, added to the catalogue)
abuse.reason: No in-scope effect creates a Line, so there is no command to abuse.

abuse.case: Naming creatures for an area spell that the area can't hold, or leaving out creatures that are in an 'each creature' area
abuse.reason: Would apply to a Line, but no in-scope effect creates one. The Cone, Cube and Sphere tests already cover this.

abuse.case: Naming yourself for an area that starts from you
abuse.reason: No in-scope Line effect starts from its creator.

not_testable.reason: Nothing in the implemented subset creates a Line. None of the 32 in-scope spells has one, and neither do the 14 monsters or the 4 species. The Line content (Lightning Bolt, Dragonborn Breath Weapon, dragon breath) is all outside §1.1. The engine has no Line geometry (geometry.in_area covers cone, cube and sphere), so a test would have to invent an API. Per CLAUDE.md, content the engine doesn't implement gets no tests.
No in-scope effect specifies a Line length and width, so the clause can't be reached through the engine.
No in-scope Line exists, so whether its point of origin is excluded can't be observed. The matching rule for Cones and Cubes is already tested under R-29 and R-31.

output.summary: GLOSS.line is out of scope: none of the in-scope spells, monsters or species creates a Line, and the engine has no Line geometry. This follows the precedent of GLOSS.cylinder and GLOSS.emanation. No tests and no tickets. One new cheat was added to loop/abuse-catalogue.md: off-centre or widened Line width, a shortened Line, and a diagonal Line measured with the grid metric. Stage A's proposed rulings (centred width, Euclidean length, full length, origin excluded) can wait until a Line effect comes into scope.
